bull_bear.body:
- Long-run dividend escalation with an unchanged capital base: dividend rose from 110% (Mar-16) to 400% (Mar-26) while paid-up capital stayed at ₹111 Cr through the period (₹111.10 Cr since Mar-13, versus ₹27.78 Cr in Mar-07); Mar-19's 175% "includes special dividend of 50%".
- Networth compounded from ₹3,313 Cr (Mar-16) to ₹12,715 Cr (Mar-26) and stood at ₹13,596 Cr at Jun-26, with book value per share at ₹1,223.7 (standalone) and ₹1,446.8 (consolidated) at Jun-26.
- Balance sheet deliberately under-levered: leverage of 4.2x and capital adequacy of 18.5% at Jun-26, versus 4.0x / 24.4% at Mar-22 — capital adequacy has trended down as leverage inched up.
- Large carrying value in group companies is explicitly separated from the core: the deck reports "Core ROE (excluding investments in subsidiaries)" alongside headline ROE, at 18.2% vs 17.7% for Q1FY27.
- Shareholding at 30-Jun-26: Promoters 37.2%, Public 32.4%, Mutual Funds & AIFs 22.4%, FIIs/FPIs and NRIs 6.0%, Banks/FIs & Insurance 2.0% (Promoters and Mutual Funds & AIFs unchanged from 30-Jun-25); largest institutional holder is Nalanda India Equity Fund Limited at 3.62%.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Strategic sources of distinctiveness" listed as: 72-year heritage of trust and prudence; pioneer of hire-purchase finance in India; and "consistent best-in-class asset quality performance over decades".
- Lending business is "focused on the underserved but aspiring Indian entrepreneur (road transport operator, infrastructure contractor, small farmer, MSME owner)", supported by a "technology-enabled and data-powered approach to a high-touch customer approach".
- Deposit franchise cited as a moat: "legacy of deep deposit customer connect and loyalty with 80% renewal rate across offerings".
- Stated vision is "to be the most respected NBFC in the country"; mission is to deliver the "Sundaram experience", with a values code ("The Sundaram Way") covering service, prudence, discipline, humility, openness, relationships, fair play, honesty and integrity.
- Group structure spans Sundaram Home Finance Ltd. (100% subsidiary), Sundaram Asset Management Company Ltd. (100% subsidiary) and Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Ltd. (Joint Venture with Ageas Insurance International NV), plus Sundaram AMC Singapore, Sundaram Trustee, Sundaram Alternate Assets, Sundaram Fund Services and LGF Services.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Labour codes] The deck carries an exceptional item captioned "Exceptional Items (Impact of New Labour Codes)" of ₹(75) Cr for FY26 and ₹(9) Cr in Q4FY26, with nil in Q1FY26 and Q1FY27.
- [Consolidation drag] Consolidated results show an "Adjustment arising out of Consolidation" of ₹(1,604) Cr on share of net worth and ₹(90) Cr on share in profit at/for Q1FY27, against ₹(1,566) Cr and ₹(125) Cr in the prior-year period.
- [JV underwriting] Royal Sundaram's Combined Operating Ratio is above 100% throughout the disclosed periods — 116.3% (Q1FY27), 109.1% (Q4FY26), 110.2% (Q1FY26) and 115.5% (FY26) — i.e. the general insurance JV is underwriting at a loss.
- [Macro framing] The deck flags that at the start of the year "the risk of an escalation in the West Asia conflict cast uncertainty over business prospects", but that "lower than expected fuel price transmission kept inflationary pressures contained".
- [Leadership] Board and KMP are long-tenured: Sri S. Viji (Chairman, 5+ decades), Sri Harsha Viji (Executive Vice Chairman), Sri Rajiv C. Lochan (Managing Director, formerly MD & CEO of The Hindu Group and Partner at McKinsey), Sri A. N. Raju (Joint Managing Director), with Sri M. Ramaswamy CFO since September 2011.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Sundaram Finance as a 72-year-old, AAA-rated NBFC and pioneer of hire-purchase finance in India, anchored on lending to "the underserved but aspiring Indian entrepreneur" and sitting at the centre of a diversified financial services group (lending, general insurance, home finance, asset management) with total AUM of over Rs. 1,80,000 cr.
